claims.statement: The natural study reuses eight development questions in two known histories from the fixed four-PDF, 550-page corpus. Question-to-history membership and version order are supplied; this is not an open-corpus lineage evaluation.

The quantized Qwen3.5-4B reader passes 8/8 authored short controls and 19/19 required facts with zero critical errors or output-budget failures. Control inputs span 197–270 native tokens, versus 1284–3242 in the natural study; the gate does not certify a generally strong reader.
claims.evidence_level: Authored model-assisted control evaluation and native token metadata

claims.statement: The source-context structural audit contains 17 required probes (7 complete, 10 missing), 15 forbidden probes (zero violations) and two locally unresolved probes with appropriate abstention. Of 50 reviewed accepted attachments, 42 are correct source context, seven add noncontent context and one contains mixed scope; zero are false under the context-only contract, which does not certify semantic attachment.

A documented pre-main-output layout amendment changed whitespace preservation in 12 parent/closure contexts without changing selected seed IDs. The 16 ordinary/paired contexts remain byte-identical to v13; layout and token identities were audited.
claims.evidence_level: Recorded development amendment and mechanical binding

claims.statement: Complete/partial/absent source-context counts are ordinary 2/4/2, paired 2/5/1, parent 2/3/3 and closure 3/4/1, each over eight questions. Shared caps do not imply equal actual native token use.

Across 32 native responses, ordinary, paired, parent and closure have respectively 1/8, 0/8, 1/8 and 1/8 jointly content-correct, scope-correct and citation-grounded answers. Two output-budget failures remain in their denominators; there are 30 unique native input token sequences.
claims.evidence_level: Completed descriptive development results, not independent replicated trials

claims.statement: Across the 16 byte-identical ordinary/paired contexts, v14 yields one joint success versus two in v13. The selected configuration fails to establish a reader upgrade; model/configuration differences do not isolate a single causal factor.
claims.evidence_level: Descriptive same-context comparison on reused development questions

claims.statement: Only 3 of 9 complete-context condition–question cells yield joint answer success. These are pooled correlated cells, not nine unique or independent questions.

The dense follow-up audits 48 source contexts and generates no natural QA answers. BM25 paired/closure yield 2/8 and 3/8 complete contexts; dense paired/closure and RRF paired/closure each yield 1/8. Required-fact support totals are 10, 12, 3, 3, 9 and 9 out of 21 respectively. This is a negative result for the frozen configuration only.
The main and dense execution audits pass 1348 and 983 checks respectively. These establish recorded identity, linkage and bookkeeping checks, not independent human semantic certification.

The witness-selection scaffold has 14 authored checks and implements only selection over externally supplied or oracle hypotheses and judgments. It has no automatic natural-data proposer or verifier and no natural-data method result. Its atomic span cost is a surrogate unless the caller supplies an appropriate native cost function, and no blanket greedy approximation guarantee is claimed.
claims.evidence_level: Executable supplied-judgment research scaffold with authored implementation checks

claims.statement: A separate source-feasibility inventory has 12 objects from six issuer pairs, with no new QA references or benchmark admission decision. Berkshire filenames labeled 2022/2023 correspond to actual fiscal years 2021/2022, so only five of six pairs meet the intended 2022–2024 window. This source-exposed material is not held-out evaluation.

Inline XBRL feasibility identifies 23651 numeric fact occurrences and 32051 exact fact/context/unit anchor checks across those 12 objects. No values are normalized or independently validated; hidden, repeated and nil occurrences prevent treating these counts as distinct usable semantic facts. Existing structured extraction is a required future baseline opportunity, not a novelty claim.
claims.evidence_level: Local markup and anchor feasibility only

claims.statement: The bounded primary-source audit identifies close existing work, including HC-RAG structural and comparison retrieval, and does not establish novelty for paired retrieval, context closure or interpretation-aware selection. No inspected-paper absence is treated as proof of an unoccupied research gap.

The final artifact is a visually reviewed seven-page generic ReportLab working draft, not a compiled or verified ACL submission. All three displayed result tables were checked against completed summaries and eight bound result hashes.

overarching_limits: All eight natural questions are reused development material across two histories; no held-out evaluation, independently adjudicated human gold, inferential significance or broad generalization is established.
The newer quantized four-billion-parameter configuration fails to establish an upgrade on the identical-context comparison; short controls do not certify competence on natural contexts.
Equal evidence-word caps are not equal native-token budgets. Parent/closure conditions package representation, surrounding context and evidence allocation changes.
Main answer judgments and source-only support judgments have distinct endpoints; the 48 dense follow-up contexts do not constitute answer-quality results.
Mechanical audits and hashes establish identity and contract bookkeeping, not independent semantic truth or extraction completeness.
The supplied-judgment selector is an inspectable research scaffold without automatic candidate generation, natural-data verification or demonstrated method benefit.

The twelve newly inventoried source objects are feasibility material, not admitted benchmark items or untouched held-out sources; original SEC identity and historical first-public availability remain unverified.
Prior-work coverage is bounded and establishes neither novelty nor publishability; no ACL 2027 compliance or submission readiness is claimed.
